project.name: WeGroween
project.audience: Quality-conscious Indian households and home cooks first; restaurant/chef/hospitality supply secondary
project.objective: Make premium fresh-produce discovery, trust, household shopping and the secondary supply path understandable

brief.offer: Microgreens, mushrooms, organic vegetables and fruits, and specialty farming products
constraints: Design system and review prototypes only
English-first, single brand, no dark mode v1
assumptions: India initial market from approved brief
Catalogue expansion, prices, pack sizes and delivery terms remain illustrative/unconfirmed
success_criteria: Synchronized sources and truthful review status

brand.theme: Every harvest is an edition worth collecting: specific, seasonal, sensory and quietly confident.
brand.vibe: Warm editorial precision. Premium without ornament, authentic without rustic nostalgia, knowledgeable without clinical language.
brand.emotion: A discerning grower with the eye of a food editor and the operational clarity of a dependable supplier.
principles: Evidence stays close to the claim
anti_principles: No stock imagery as cultivation evidence
brand.tone: V1 Cultivated Authority: precise, sensory, warm, transparent and calm. Concrete nouns/verbs; short headings and plain full sentences.
copy_examples: This bed is resting. Join the next harvest list.
We could not confirm that payment. Your basket is safe; try again or choose another method.
brand.iconography: I1 Field Notes: 24px grid, 1.75px optical stroke, square terminals, rounded joins, open counters and crop-specific asymmetry. Icons inherit currentColor; icon-only targets require names and 44px targets.
brand.motion_purpose: M1 continuity and immediate state feedback: 140/220/360ms. Reduced motion removes translation and decorative reveals; no critical information depends on animation.

research.summary: Reuse 2026-10-02 research: premium should come from variety, provenance, harvest, handling, delivery and remedy specificity; households remain primary and restaurant supply secondary.

sources.title: Current WeGroween static catalogue
sources.observation: Four-page static catalogue with earthy tokens embedded separately in each page, a script wordmark, bento cards, CDN-delivered Tailwind and AOS, placeholder links, and no functional cart, checkout, account, API, database, or admin.
sources.interpretation: The existing visual vocabulary can inform continuity, but the implementation must be replaced by a governed application architecture.
limitations: No production analytics or user research available
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Sanesa Yourganic
sources.observation: Uses source verification, same-day cut-offs, refunds, fulfilment detail, sourcing policy, and a named integrity-check process as trust mechanisms.
sources.interpretation: Operational transparency is a stronger premium cue than decorative luxury language.
limitations: Claims were not independently audited
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Bhoomi Farms
sources.observation: Pairs source traceability with a membership model, next-day delivery, pause controls, broad category navigation, and explicit certification links.
sources.interpretation: WeGroween should support one-off buying first while leaving room for repeat boxes or subscriptions after operational validation.
limitations: Subscription economics are business-specific
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Gourmet Mushroom Company
sources.observation: Builds specialty credibility through an award, locally grown sourcing, chemical-use clarity, freshness, product education, and restaurant relationships while remaining approachable to home cooks.
sources.interpretation: Restaurant proof can strengthen the household proposition when it is supporting evidence rather than the dominant navigation.
limitations: Contact-led rather than full commerce flow
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Microgreen Store Gurgaon
sources.observation: Frames ordering around harvest windows, box entitlements, upcoming availability, delivery status, storage guidance, and familiar Indian meal usage.
sources.interpretation: Harvest-state communication can make operational constraints feel like premium freshness rather than stock failure.
limitations: Prelaunch or early-stage operating evidence
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Riverford Organic Farmers
sources.observation: Connects seasonality, grower traceability, repeat boxes, add-ons, easy pause/skip controls, delivery windows, and recipe education.
sources.interpretation: WeGroween can treat seasonality and repeat purchase as service design, not only brand copy.
limitations: UK logistics and subscription habits differ from India
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Oishii Farms
sources.observation: Premium value is expressed through varietal specificity, sensory language, controlled-environment craft, named farms, human expertise, and precise product photography rather than generic luxury motifs.
sources.interpretation: WeGroween should make cultivation and sensory distinctions concrete, while avoiding imitation of Oishii's Japanese cultural expression.
limitations: Luxury berry category and US distribution differ
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Natoora
sources.observation: Uses radical seasonality, grower stories, culinary content, diversity of varieties, and an editorial visual system to connect chefs and home cooks.
sources.interpretation: A strong editorial layer can unify broad categories without turning WeGroween into a generic supermarket.
limitations: Distinctive identity must not be reproduced
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: EZTrolley
sources.observation: Restaurant value centers on real-time stock, fast ordering, repeat orders, delivery tracking, automated GST invoices, account support, and broad procurement coverage.
sources.interpretation: WeGroween should separate restaurant onboarding and account workflows while reusing the core catalogue.
limitations: Claims and scale were not independently verified
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Baymard 2026 Grocery Ecommerce UX Research
sources.observation: Grocery-specific friction clusters around fulfilment availability, substitutions, large repeat baskets, past purchases, and finding critical product attributes.
sources.interpretation: WeGroween should expose serviceability and delivery before checkout, support buy-again, and keep substitution control global with exceptions.
limitations: Many detailed guidelines are behind a paid research library
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.observation: Interactive components need programmatic name, role, state, and value; dynamic status messages must be exposed to assistive technology without requiring focus changes.
sources.interpretation: Accessibility must be embedded in component contracts and tested states, not added after visual design.
limitations: Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

sources.title: FSSAI Advisory for E-commerce Food Business Operators
sources.observation: Food-commerce listings and operations require valid FSSAI identification, alignment between online and physical-label claims, safe last-mile handling, and adequate remaining shelf life.
sources.interpretation: Compliance fields must be supported in product/admin data and surfaced where legally required; claims cannot be invented for design effect.
limitations: Legal configuration requires qualified review before launch
Historical source; not live reverified during schema migration
sources.rights: Reference only; no identity, copy or asset reuse inferred

composition.attention: Household offer and shopping first, evidence near action, restaurant supply secondary; preserve honest alternate routes
composition.negative_space: Macro: separate H1 narrative chapters with approved section rhythm. Meso: distinguish copy/media and peer groups. Micro: token gaps within labels, icons, controls and card anatomy. Space clarifies relationships, not a generic premium claim.
composition.density: G3 Curated Market: 1200px content, 12 columns, 20px canonical gutter; preserve efficient catalogue and restrained editorial headings
composition.responsive_priorities: Preserve essential price, pack, status, navigation and next action; reflow into readable stacked regions; do not clip meaningful text; 35% text expansion and 200% reflow checks pending
composition.conflict_resolution: Safety/accessibility/truthfulness, task comprehension, approved brand/business intent, then decoration; material compromises need leader choice
exceptions: Preserve approved R3 imagery authorization despite empty-media default
composition.status: DERIVED documentation of approved H1; migration additions accepted 2026-10-05

imagery.thesis: Cultivation and ingredient detail support quiet premium confidence; product color remains truthful
imagery.warmth: Natural neutral to gently warm; preserve believable daylight and food whites
imagery.tint: Avoid green casts and artificial palette tints
imagery.saturation: Restrained to moderate; no exaggerated green or fake freshness
imagery.exposure: Keep highlight texture and shadow detail; avoid luminous fake dew or crushed substrate
imagery.contrast: Readable food texture without harsh global contrast; overlays need their own contrast check
imagery.lighting: Soft directional daylight-like light; no clinical glare or stage-lit spectacle
imagery.texture: Preserve actual skin, leaf, mushroom, substrate and packing texture; restrained retouching
imagery.depth: Subject-led separation; keep cultivation context legible where it acts as evidence
imagery.composition: Macro food detail, scale, hands, growing beds, harvest and finished-food context; quiet backgrounds around conversion copy
imagery.crop: Product 4:3; square packshot allowed; hero/editorial 4:5 or 5:4. Preserve current R3 media geometry
imagery.negative_space: Reserve focal-safe regions for overlays; do not move copy over busy texture
imagery.background: Natural low-distraction mineral/paper/kitchen/growing contexts; separate packshot consistency from documentary evidence
imagery.palette_compatibility: C2 frames cool greens naturally; C1 blackberry remains restrained; C3 must not make food look like beauty/wine. Never grade merchandise to fit a palette.
archetype_rules: Catalogue: consistent angle/scale/padding for comparable food, no price or unit hidden
Food: appetite through credible texture and clean handling
B2B: show process evidence and labelled quantities; no invented chef testimonials
imagery.people: Hands and cultivators may explain process; obtain consent/model/property rights; avoid staged stereotypes or implied endorsements
imagery.generated_imagery: No new generated images are requested. Generated scenes may not be cultivation/provenance evidence; any future production needs separate authorization and human artifact review.
imagery.accessibility: Meaningful alt text identifies variety/context; decorative media uses empty alt; overlays require readable contrast; responsive crops preserve focal subject
imagery.performance: Use existing WebP where appropriate; define responsive crops and dimensions; optimize without food-color or texture loss; measure later
imagery.rights: R3 project-image prototype use authorized on 2026-10-03; ownership/public/production rights unverified. Exclude visible-watermark candidates. Fonts have bundled OFL.
examples: Do: natural mushroom texture against quiet soil/mineral context
Do: label cultivation evidence only when verified
Do not: tint greens to match the palette
Do not: use stock/generated farms as WeGroween evidence
imagery.status: APPROVED project treatment expansion on 2026-10-05; rights limitations retained
imagery.provenance: BRAND_IDENTITY_BLUEPRINT.md section 9 and assets/README.md; new qualitative bands are authored proposals, not measured edit settings
